metadata.title: New Wave Portrait with Vertical Outlined Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait featuring dramatic cyan-blue lighting and a vertical column of thin, outlined custom lettering on a black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast male portrait where one side of the face is bathed in cool cyan light and the other is lost in deep black shadow, paired with a vertical stack of ultra-thin, geometric outlined lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text alignment balancing the off-center portrait
Thin geometric outlines contrasting with soft airbrushed skin textures
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space on the left third
Vertical orientation of the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is cropped tightly, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit cyan eye and the vertical text column act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, moves down the vertical text on the left, and returns to the gaze of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the left side provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue for highlights and mid-tones on the skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for deep shadows and the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale peach/white for the brightest skin highlights and thin white/red for text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the glowing cyan skin tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read vertically upwards

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the black negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, condensed sans-serif in a contrasting color (red) is used for secondary metadata above the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric and thin qualities suitable for modification
Geometric structure that can be elongated

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast close-up portrait of a man with 80s style hair, lit with a strong cyan-blue light from the right, leaving the left side of the frame in deep black shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, outlined, ultra-thin geometric lettering in the black space on the left, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the text outlined and vertically oriented?
Is there a strong black-to-cyan contrast?
Is the skin texture airbrushed and smooth?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector-like outlines for text
Smooth color gradients in the cyan highlights

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the face
Verify the cyan color is vibrant and not washed out
Check that the vertical text is legible despite the rotation
